dialogs.demoteMessage: Are you sure you want to demote {name} to {role}?
dialogs.disableMessage: Are you sure you want to disable {name}? They will be unable to log in.
dialogs.resetMessage: This will generate a new temporary password for {name}. They will be required to change it on next login.
dialogs.unlinkSsoMessage: This converts the account of {name} to a local account. A later SSO sign-in with the same email address can link it again. The system generates a temporary password, and {name} must change it on next login.
dialogs.unlinkSsoResultDesc: The account of {name} is now a local account. Share this temporary password with them to sign in.
dialogs.resetTwoFactorMessage: This switches off two-factor authentication for {name}, deletes their backup codes and trusted devices, and signs them out everywhere. They can then sign in with their password and set up 2FA again. Use it when they have lost their authenticator and backup codes, or after JWT_SECRET was changed.
dialogs.deleteMessage: Are you sure you want to delete {name}? This will permanently remove their account and all associated data. This action cannot be undone. If they are a delegate of another account, their own data is removed but their login is kept so the delegation still works -- they become a delegate-only user.
dialogs.tempPasswordDescCreated: A temporary password was generated for {name}. Share it with them to sign in.
dialogs.tempPasswordDescUpgraded: An existing shared user was upgraded to a full account. Share this temporary password with {name}.

notificationsPage.title: Notifications
notificationsPage.subtitle: Delivery channels this Monize instance offers, and the push identity behind them.
notificationsPage.loadUnavailable: Monize could not read the notification settings from the server. Reload the page to try again.
notificationsPage.perAccountNote: Devices, test notifications and per-notification preferences belong to each account and are managed in Settings. An administrator configures the instance and never sends to, or sees, another person’s notifications.

inApp.name: In-app notifications
inApp.description: The bell in the header. Always available and cannot be switched off: it is where a notification lives even when every other channel fails.

webPush.name: Browser push
webPush.description: Notifications delivered to a phone or desktop even when Monize is closed. Needs no Firebase, Google Play or Apple Developer account.
webPush.toggleLabel: Enable browser push for this instance
webPush.missingKeys: This instance has no push key pair. Set ENCRYPTION_KEY and restart: Monize generates the pair itself on the next start.
webPush.keyUnreadable: This instance cannot decrypt its stored push key pair, so nothing can be delivered. Rotate the key pair below to recover.
webPush.serverKeyMissing: This instance has no ENCRYPTION_KEY, so it cannot open the push key pair it stored. Set ENCRYPTION_KEY in the deployment and restart — rotating cannot help while the key is missing.

email.name: Email
email.description: Bill reminders, budget digests and system alerts sent to each account’s email address.
email.missingSmtp: No mail server is configured. Set the SMTP environment variables to enable email.
email.statusUnavailable: Monize could not read the mail server status.

ntfy.name: ntfy and UnifiedPush
ntfy.description: The same encrypted push, delivered to a self-hosted UnifiedPush distributor (ntfy, NextPush) instead of Google or Apple infrastructure. It shares this instance’s push key pair and switch; each person registers their endpoint from their UnifiedPush app and turns the channel on in Settings.
ntfy.followsWebPush: Unavailable while browser push is off or its key pair cannot be used — this channel is delivered with the same key pair.

identity.rotateDescription: Rotating replaces this instance’s key pair. Every registered device stops being reachable and has to turn push on again, so rotate only if the key may have been exposed.
identity.missingEncryptionKey: This instance has no push key pair, because ENCRYPTION_KEY is not set and the private key would have to be stored unencrypted. Set it and restart: Monize generates the pair itself.
identity.keyUnreadable: This instance holds a push key pair it can no longer decrypt, so nothing can be delivered. It happens when ENCRYPTION_KEY changes under a live database, or when a backup is restored onto a different instance. Rotate the key pair to recover; every device will register again.
identity.serverKeyMissing: This instance has no ENCRYPTION_KEY set, so it cannot open the push key pair it stored. Rotating will not help while the key is missing: set ENCRYPTION_KEY in the deployment and restart, and push works again with the existing devices.

dialogs.rotateMessage: {count, plural, =0 {No device is registered yet, so nothing is lost.} one {One registered device will stop receiving notifications until someone turns push back on in that browser.} other {# registered devices will stop receiving notifications until someone turns push back on in each browser.}}

toasts.pushEnabled: Browser push enabled for this instance
toasts.pushDisabled: Browser push disabled for this instance
toasts.pushToggleFailed: Could not change the browser push setting
toasts.rotated: {count, plural, =0 {Key pair rotated} one {Key pair rotated; 1 device must register again} other {Key pair rotated; # devices must register again}}
toasts.rotateFailed: Could not rotate the key pair

backupsPage.title: Backups
backupsPage.subtitle: Scheduled, compressed backup files of every account's own financial records.

scope.heading: Not a full database backup
scope.perUser: On the schedule below, the server writes a compressed backup file of each account's own financial records and prunes older ones by the retention policy. Every active account is covered.
scope.notFullDatabase: It is not a PostgreSQL dump: it captures no schema, no server configuration and nothing outside an account's own financial records. For whole-instance disaster recovery, back up the database and the attachment storage with your own tools.

demoRestricted.heading: Restricted in Demo Mode
demoRestricted.body: Automatic-backup configuration is disabled in demo mode.
